findings.reason: The test checks the client-side composition rule against its own local `composeProjectUrl` helper, which re-implements the rule and also adds `encodeURIComponent`, unlike production. It does not exercise the real composition in `src/client/lib/api-core.ts` (`apiFetch` / `API_BASE`). If `apiFetch` regressed, this test would still pass. Consider asserting the URL `apiFetch` produces with `fetch` stubbed and `window.__C4S_PROJECT__` set, or drop the helper and use the literal URL.
